raw_sections.personal_information: Senior IT Project & Program Manager | Agile Delivery Leader Bangalore, India • +91 9019253871 • pradeep.kempanna@gmail.com • LinkedIn
raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior IT Project & Program Manager with 22+ years delivering mission-critical programs across Banking, Financial Services, and Cybersecurity. Certified Scrum Master and Product Owner with a record of leading large- scale Agile transformations, building and mentoring global cross-functional teams, and delivering complex COTS, infrastructure, and data-migration initiatives for SWIFT, Capital One, Lloyds Banking Group, and Wipro.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
Delivery & PM: Project & Program Management • Delivery Governance • Release & Incident Management • Risk & Dependency Management • SDLC • Application Support Agile: Agile & Scrum Transformation • SAFe / PI Planning • Backlog Management • Coaching & Mentoring • ATDD • Continuous Delivery Leadership: Stakeholder & People Management • Offshore–Onshore Coordination • Vendor Management • Team Leadership Domain: Banking & Financial Services • Cybersecurity & Infrastructure • AML • Basel • Retail Banking Tools: Jira • Confluence • ServiceNow • MS Project • DataStage • Tanium
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
SWIFT Inc — Senior Project Manager Senior Project Manager (via Agasti LLC) • Virginia, USA • Cybersecurity & Infrastructure
Aug 2021 – Aug 2025
Led delivery of enterprise cybersecurity and infrastructure programs aligned to SWIFT's strategic roadmap, owning scope, schedule, and quality across Agile teams following the Spotify Model.
Managed program-level risks, cross-team dependencies, and stakeholder communications across globally distributed teams.
Strengthened delivery governance by establishing a weekly program health dashboard for senior stakeholders, replacing ad-hoc status updates, and improving leadership confidence in delivery predictability.
Spearheaded the enterprise-wide adoption of SWIFT's mandatory independent assessment process, coordinating across global teams to achieve full compliance attestation ahead of annual deadlines — with zero non-compliance flags raised.
Capital One — Agile Delivery Lead Agile Delivery Lead (via Agasti LLC) • Virginia, USA
Mar 2019 – Jul 2021
Led 3 Agile teams through Scrum adoption and continuous-delivery practices, improving sprint predictability and delivery throughput.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, backlog management, and PI planning across teams, removing impediments to keep delivery on track.
Partnered with Product Owners and business stakeholders to deliver enhancements to Capital One's digital banking platform, improving customer self-service capabilities, and reducing manual processing time.
SWIFT Inc — Project Manager Project Manager (via Agasti LLC) • Virginia, USA • Global COTS Rollouts & Upgrades
Jan 2017 – Mar 2019
Delivered multiple cybersecurity and infrastructure COTS programs — ServiceNow, Tanium, NetMRI, IPAM, and Oracle Tuxedo — across the US, Europe, Hong Kong, and Kuala Lumpur.
Owned end-to-end delivery, risk mitigation, and production rollouts for globally distributed teams spanning multiple time zones, ensuring zero-defect go-lives.
Defined business requirements with stakeholders, translated them into project plans, and maintained continual progress reporting to team, customers, and the project office.
Capital One — Agile Scrum Master Agile Scrum Master (via Wipro) • Virginia & Delaware, USA
Apr 2013 – Jan 2017
Coached and transformed 13 Agile Scrum teams (6–11 members each) across Retail Banking, AML, Basel, and Big Data programs — including Spark Pay, KYC, Fill the Lake, and Basel compliance initiatives. • Embedded Agile best practices — ATDD, pair programming, sprint ceremonies, and self-organizing teams
— enabling Capital One's squads to shift from waterfall to sprint-based continuous delivery.
Facilitated Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Grooming, Reviews, and Retrospectives, and coached both onshore and offshore team members in the Scrum framework.
Wipro Technologies — Project Manager / Engagement Lead / Transition ManagerNov 2003 – Mar 2013 Project Manager / Engagement Lead / Transition Manager • Bangalore, India • Virginia, USA Clients: Capital One, Lloyds Banking Group, Nortel
Delivered Europe's largest data warehouse migration for Lloyds Banking Group — migrating 35 million Halifax bank accounts onto the Lloyds platform using DataStage — leading a 17-person offshore team and coordinating with client SMEs to deliver on schedule.
Managed banking transformation, application support, migration, and transition programs across Capital One, Lloyds Banking Group, and Nortel — spanning development, L3 incident management, and knowledge transition across offshore and onshore teams in India, the UK, and the USA.
Led offshore–onshore coordination and SLA delivery for Capital One's DDE data distribution platform — managing a team of 30, presenting daily/weekly/monthly status reports to the client, and ensuring L3 incident resolution and release governance targets were consistently met.
